para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to competitive but sustainable pricing, and we think both firms do better by avoiding a race to the bottom.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to keep our prices competitive yet sustainable, since we believe both companies are better off steering clear of a race to the bottom.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're aiming for a fair, sustainable margin, and we're happy to keep prices stable if you are, since sharp undercutting would hurt us both.
para_examples.delivered: We intend to maintain a fair and sustainable profit margin, and we're glad to hold prices steady as long as you do the same, because aggressive undercutting would harm us both.

para_examples.original: Statement: We appreciate your signal in Round 1, and we're happy to keep prices at a sustainable level as long as you do the same, since undercutting would hurt us both.
para_examples.delivered: Thank you for your signal in the first round. We are glad to keep our prices at a sustainable level, provided you do likewise, since undercutting would harm us both.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're glad we both see the value in avoiding a race to the bottom, so we'll hold our price at 1.60 as long as you do.
para_examples.delivered: We're pleased that we share a view on the importance of not undercutting each other into ruin, so we will keep our price at 1.60 for as long as you keep yours there.
